declared_scale: One module (src/main.py), one builder task, 13 frozen studio cases of which 9 are held out, plus 17 extended held-out cases run after the build
authored: Written new on 2026-11-19 for the thesis AI-only run (ADR-0133), before any run of any kind. Not a copy of an earlier benchmark. The expected outputs were produced by the reference solution and checked by hand against the spec; a test runs the reference against every case and each known failure against the cases that catch it

expected_requests.note: Each round is one builder request (or one per part when the builder answers in parts) and one reviewer request; repair rounds and parts are measured, not required

expected_cost_usd: 0.00 on a plan-backed route (plan_roles). Any metered route is out of this run
one_build_per_attempt: The single attempt is its own product and build in the studio qualification harness, from this spec.json content exactly (no catalog run, selection or spec is created)
qualified_at_declared_scale_when: In this run the qualification harness records the task outcome: qualified means the single attempt met every pass bar (the task is completed); not_qualified means it did not. Nothing is re-run to replace a failure. A pass here lifts no build label
invalid_attempt_when: An infrastructure fault outside the roles stops the attempt before a verdict: a role request that got no answer (network, provider, rate or usage limit, sign-in, token or timeout), a request the studio refused for a reason the roles' work did not cause (an earlier request with an unknown outcome, another request still running past a 4-minute wait, the daily cap, a lost sign-in, a connection setting changed during the run), a worker that did not finish a case, or a studio restart. It is recorded with its cause, and each attempt may be replaced at most once. A role answer the role itself caused to end without the contract (output too long or incomplete, out of turns, a model other than the one asked for, or a refusal to serve the model asked for, on any route) is a failed attempt, not an infrastructure fault; so is a request refused because the roles' own output made its input larger than the per-request input cap recorded at Start, or because the attempt used its request limit. An input-cap refusal of an attempt's first request (the roles wrote nothing yet), or after the cap was lowered since Start, is an infrastructure fault
pass_bar_per_attempt: Studio build reaches verified_candidate: QA passes every frozen studio case, held-out ones included, in the isolation worker, and the reviewer approves with no findings (the studio's own rule)
Requests used are at most the plan's max_calls (6)
The exported package is verified by the studio: every frozen case re-run on the extracted archive in the isolation worker
All 17 extended cases pass on the exported package, run by the studio in the isolation worker with the studio case rule (exact output and exit status)
min_input_chars_note: Start refuses a connection whose per-request input cap is below 60,000 characters (the dev studio's recorded cap, ADR-0062), so an attempt cannot fail on a cap smaller than the one the run is planned for
answer_wrapping_note: The same answer form p14-xl-v1 and p14-larger-ledgercheck-v6 accept (ADR-0115): one json code fence, optionally preceded by at most 8 whole-line invoke tags, which are dropped unread and counted
measure_and_record: requests used, builder parts per round and repair rounds used
wall time from start to verdict
reviewer verdict and findings, and the build reason
studio case results (development and held out) as the record keeps them
package manifest SHA-256 and archive SHA-256

known_failure_cases.description: A shift also covers its END minute
Overlapping shifts of one person count that person twice
Blank and comment lines are not counted in line numbers
A gap is printed ending at its last minute instead of the minute after it
Nothing printed instead of no gaps when there is no gap
An opening time equal to the closing time is accepted
Times with one-digit hours or out-of-range values are accepted
